info.title: Tiller board API
info.description: The daemon's board API (docs/spec/protocol.md section 7). Every path answers only on 127.0.0.1, localhost or an --allow-host name; at an --allow-host name every path but the signed-out screen and signing in needs the owner cookie; mutations need the owner cookie and the board's own origin.

200.description: `data` is a `RestartStaleResponse`

post.summary:
Escape to a working agent's pane, and whether its turn ended within
10 s: `tiller agent interrupt` on the session's run (`protocol.md` 6.4,
7.4). The request waits for the proof.

200.description: `data.cancel` is `confirmed` or `unconfirmed`, with `data.evidence`

422.description: `refused`: the agent is not working, has no run, pane or agent, or this key already sent its Escape; nothing was sent

post.summary:
A dated pause on the session's run, which silences its alarms until
then: `tiller run pause` (`protocol.md` 6.4, 7.4).

200.description: `data` is the run

400.description: a date that does not parse, or an empty or too long reason

422.description: `refused`: an orchestrator, an ended run, or a date not in the future

post.summary:
The dialog on a waiting agent's screen, for the board's answer buttons
(`protocol.md` 7.4): a permission dialog, or a cursor menu of a known
layout. The screen is read only while the agent's session says it waits.
A POST with every mutation check, as the mirror is, though it writes
nothing.

404.description: no such agent, or its pane closed

422.description: `refused`: the agent runs on a saved machine

503.description: herdr is unreachable, or reads and input came faster than 20 a second

post.summary:
One option of the dialog on a waiting agent's screen (`protocol.md`
7.4): a permission dialog's digit alone, or a cursor menu's arrow keys
to the option's row, then Enter. The screen is read again first, and
nothing is typed unless its dialog is the one `screen` names.

400.description: an option the dialog does not offer

404.description: no such agent, or its pane closed

409.description: `screen_changed`: the agent no longer waits, or the dialog on its screen is not the one `screen` names; nothing was sent

422.description: `refused`: the agent runs on a saved machine

503.description: herdr is unreachable, or input came faster than 20 a second; nothing was sent

post.summary:
A new session on the run, in the same worktree, after a proven stop of
the live one: `tiller agent relaunch` (`protocol.md` 6.4, 7.4).

200.description: `data` is the relaunch: `run`, `session`, `ended_session`, `stop_proof`, `pane_id`, `started`, `evidence`

400.description: an empty or too long note

422.description: `refused`: an orchestrator, an ended run, a worktree on another branch, a brief that is missing, or a stop that could not be proven; nothing was changed

post.summary:
`claude --resume` in the run's worktree for a session whose agent is
gone: `tiller agent resume` (`protocol.md` 6.4, 7.4).

200.description: `data` is the resume: `run`, `session`, `pane_id`, `left_alone`, `started`, `evidence`

422.description: `refused`: an orchestrator, an ended run, no Claude session to resume, or another host

post.summary:
One line for an agent, typed into its pane when the pane is idle: the
outbox path of `tiller send --kind steer` (`protocol.md` 3.3, 7.4).

200.description: The queued outbox message; `receipt.outbox_id` names it

400.description: an empty line, a line break, or more than 20,000 characters

422.description: `refused`: the session has ended

post.summary:
The proven stop of `tiller agent stop` (`protocol.md` 6.4, 7.4): a
worker whose run has ended, or an orchestrator. The request waits for
the proof.

200.description: `data` is the stop: `session`, `stop_proof`, `cleaned`, `closed_pane`, `warning`

422.description: `refused`: the run is active, the pane holds a draft or a dialog, or the agent runs on another host or a saved machine; nothing was sent

post.summary:
The terminal mirror: the agent's live pane as NDJSON (`protocol.md`
7.4). A POST, so it passes every mutation check, owner cookie included,
though it writes nothing.

200.description: One `TerminalLine` per line: `size`, then `frame`s, until `closed` or `unavailable` or the end of the body; `unfit` when herdr would not resize the pane for the Fit

400.description: a `fit` outside 20 to 500 cols by 5 to 200 rows

404.description: no such agent, or its pane closed

422.description: `refused`: the agent runs on a saved machine

503.description: herdr is unreachable, or too many terminal views are open

post.summary:
A new board size for the Fit an open stream holds on the agent's pane,
sent to herdr's control session in place (`protocol.md` 7.4).

400.description: a size outside 20 to 500 cols by 5 to 200 rows

422.description: `refused`: no open stream holds a Fit on the pane, or the agent runs on a saved machine

post.summary:
The pane's scrollback, for the board to read back without herdr
(`protocol.md` 7.4). A POST, as the mirror is: it passes every mutation
check, owner cookie included, though it writes nothing.

404.description: no such agent, or its pane closed

422.description: `refused`: the agent runs on a saved machine

post.summary: Keys or a paste for the agent's pane, through herdr (`protocol.md` 7.4).

422.description: `refused`: the agent runs on a saved machine

503.description: herdr is unreachable, or input came faster than 20 a second; nothing was sent

post.summary:
The pane's visible screen and its size, read once, for an agent on a
saved machine: herdr's observe stream stays on the machine the pane runs
on, but its read goes there with `--machine` (`protocol.md` 7.4). A POST
with every mutation check, as the mirror is, though it writes nothing.

404.description: no such agent, or its pane closed

503.description: herdr, or the saved machine, is unreachable, or 4 tail reads are in flight

post.summary:
Clears the dated pause on the session's run, as a manual resume does:
the board's Resume on a paused agent (`protocol.md` 7.4).

200.description: `data` is the run

422.description: `refused`: an orchestrator or an ended run
the head moved: `current.head_sha` is the bound head
the question still applies

200.description: `data.away` is the ended contract, `null` when away mode was off; `data.brief` is its return brief

`data` is the `BackupRow` the run left: `verified`, or `failed` with the reason. A failed run keeps the previous verified backup. A retry with the last run's key gets its row again, `replayed`, and waits for it while that run is going

422.description: `refused`: fleet, a retired project, or another host's project

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ULID, short form or display id

503.description: `peer_unreachable`: the cached card row is in `current`

200.description: `data` is the dependency

422.description: a loop, a card waiting on itself, or a closed card

200.description: `data` is the removed dependency, or null when none was left to remove

parameters.name: host
parameters.description: A peer's label for a peer's card; absent means this host.

503.description: `peer_unreachable`: the cached card row is in `current`

200.description: `data` is the key and the value; `warning` says what else the change leaves wrong

400.description: `usage`: not a setting the board sets, or a value a start would refuse

get.summary:
The checks `tiller doctor` runs, run now on this host or, with
`?host=<label>`, on a paired peer (`protocol.md` 7.3). A peer runs its own
checks and sends them as a `query` answer; the board only reads them.

The change stream: `event: change` with a [`ChangeEvent`] per `events`
row, `event: reset` with a [`ResetEvent`] when a resume is impossible,
and, once a peer is paired, `event: peer`, `event: link` and
`event: peer_reset` from the peer links (`protocol.md` 7.6), with no id.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description:
Resume after this `seq` when the request has no `Last-Event-ID`:
the boot snapshot's `last_event_seq` on the first connect.

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID
parameters.description: the last seq the client applied

200.description: `change` messages carry a ChangeEvent; `reset` messages a ResetEvent; `peer` messages a PeerEvent, `link` messages a LinkEvent and `peer_reset` messages a PeerResetEvent

429.description: `too_many_streams`: this session already holds 64 open streams

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A grant's ULID or its short form

200.description: `data` is the revoked grant; revoking a revoked grant returns it

get.summary:
The daemon's own health: versions, pollers and tools, no work data. It
answers before `tiller init` too.

409.description: `conflict`: `rev` is stale; `current` holds the new `rev` and the stored value of the first field the edit changes

422.description: `refused`: the label is taken or a peer is paired, or memory, a backup or an export records the boundary
the question still applies

post.summary:
Signs in with the 8-digit code `tiller board --login` prints, as the
link does: sets the owner cookie. It passes the mutation checks but the
cookie. The limits count per client (`auth::Client`): a client's wrong
code counts against every pending code, each of which burns for that
client on its third, and each client has only so many tries a minute;
a pending code burns for everyone only at `auth::CODE_MISS_CEILING`.
The code is never logged.

200.description: signed in: the response sets the owner cookie

403.description: `wrong_code`: wrong, used, expired or burned for this client; `code_burned`: too many wrong codes, so the pending code no longer works for this client; or a failed origin check

429.description: `too_many_tries`: this client, or its IPv6 network, had its tries for this minute; nothing was checked

post.summary:
Signs this browser out: its owner cookie stops working here and now, on
every host name, and the browser is told to drop it. Other browsers stay
signed in.

200.description: signed out: the response clears the owner cookie

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description:
The document to show: a project id, or `fleet` (the default) for
"All projects (shared)".

422.description: already undone, the document changed, or the revert conflicts with a later edit
the document changed since the board showed it, or the scrub flagged the line
a proposal is not open, the document changed, or a Keep is over the startup budget; earlier decisions in the batch stand

200.description: What the holdout eval would cost, and why it would not start
The eval started; the memory view's `evals` shows it until it records

422.description: the plan's refusal: not proposed, the text moved, a set is measuring, the gate needs no run, no evals checkout, under the quota floor, or an eval is running

200.description: The new proposal, on the current text; the old one is closed

422.description: not proposed, made on the current text already, the document changed since the board showed it, or the change no longer applies

200.description: The revision behind a provenance hint
`data` is the revoked key; revoking a revoked key returns it
The paired host row, with `ssh`, `key_id` and the key's `fingerprint`; never the key

422.description: `label_taken`: this host's own label, or one already paired; `already_paired`: the alias or the host it reaches is paired under another label

502.description: `peer_refused`: the new host refused the pairing (`reason`), or a `host` was sent

503.description: `peer_unreachable`: ssh did not reach the new host, or it gave no answer in 30 s

200.description: `data` is the host row, no longer paired; a host not paired is a no-op that deletes a key file left behind. `warning` says when the row is unpaired but the key file was not deleted

post.summary:
Run now: ends one poller's wait so it polls at once, then answers with
its health after that poll, or as it stands when the poll takes longer
than [`POLL_NOW_WAIT`]. A wake writes nothing, so the key is not
replayed: a retry is natural.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: A poller's source, as `/api/v1/health` names it

200.description: `data` is the poller's `PollerHealth`

parameters.name: retired
parameters.description: `true` lists this host's retired projects instead.

422.description: `refused`: the id is taken by a different project; `unsuitable_checkout`: the Local checkout folder does not suit

502.description: `peer_refused`: not forwarded; `clone_failed`: the clone into the Local checkout folder failed

parameters.name: project
parameters.description:
The project id; an empty Local checkout folder is named after it.
Absent is the same as empty: the board drops empty parameters.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: The folder as typed; absent or empty is `<spawn.checkouts_root>/<id>`.

parameters.name: clone
parameters.description: `true` checks the folder as one to clone into.

409.description: `conflict`: `rev` is stale; `current` holds the new `rev` and the stored value of the first field the edit changes

422.description: `refused`: the project is retired
`refused`: an agent that did not stop, an executing approval, the fleet project, or another host's project or agent

200.description: `data` is the new grant

400.description: `usage`: the kind, the conditions or `expires` is not one a grant takes

422.description: `refused`: an open card, the fleet project, or an agent that did not stop

200.description: Full retros of the last 30 days and every unfinished one, newest first

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A retro id, or a card reference for its newest retro

200.description: The retro is claimed and its curator runs; `data` is the claimed retro, and `GET /api/v1/retros` shows how the run ends

422.description: done with an outcome other than unfinished, its curator still runs, or another retro of the same card runs

503.description: `peer_unreachable`: the cached card row is in `current`

get.summary: Whether this browser holds a live owner cookie, for the board's Sign out.

403.description: `signed_out`: at an --allow-host name, without the owner cookie

get.summary: The boot snapshot, also served alone for a silent refetch after `reset`.

AcceptedKey.description: A board whose key this host accepted: `tiller peer list`'s `accepted`.

revoked_at.description: Set once the key is revoked; a revoked key never comes back.

AddPeer.description:
`POST /api/v1/peers`: Add a host in Settings pairs this host with another
one, as `tiller peer add` does (`protocol.md` 10.1, From the board).

host.description: A paired peer's label. Refused: a pairing is never forwarded.

label.description:
The name the new host goes by on this board: a letter or digit, then
letters, digits, `_` or `-`.

scope.description: `act`: read it and forward the owner's mutations; or `read`.

ssh.description: The ssh alias that reaches it from this host, with no password.

AddProject.description:
`POST /api/v1/projects`: register a project on this host, as `tiller
project add` does with the fields the board asks for. `--checks`,
`--remote`, `--default-branch` and the deploy flags stay CLI-only.

capacity.description: How many builders may run at once; absent takes the default.

oneOf.description:
The local checkout to set as `checkouts.<id>`, as `tiller config set`
does; absent leaves the key as it is.

host.description: A paired peer's label. Refused: a project add is not forwarded.

name.description: Absent or empty: the id. The board's Add project asks for no name.

repo.description: The GitHub repo, `owner/name`; absent for a project with none.

AgentControlBody.description:
`POST /api/v1/agents/{session}/stop` and `.../resume`: `tiller agent
stop` and `tiller agent resume` through the commands' own path
(`protocol.md` 6.4, 7.4).

host.description: A paired peer's label; a stop or a resume is not forwarded.

AgentRow.description: A live session: an orchestrator with its workers nested, or a worker.

as_of.description:
A peer row's freshness: the peer's `server_time` of the newest frame
its cache took. Absent on this host's rows.

host.description:
The owning host's label, on every row once a peer is paired
(`protocol.md` 7.3); absent on a host with none.

last_output_at.description:
When the agent last produced output: a tool call, a subagent or the
end of a turn, as hooks report them (`protocol.md` 7.3). Null before
its first, and on a host with hooks blocked.

oneOf.description: A peer row's link state; absent on this host's rows.
The run's dated pause (`run.pause`), while its date is ahead.
Present when the session runs an older tiller than its host does now.

state_since.description: When the session entered its current activity.

orchestrators.description:
Orchestrators with their workers; workers whose orchestrator has ended
are listed at the top level.

tiller_version.description: The tiller version of the host that answered.

answer.description:
The owner's exact words, at most 20,000 characters (`protocol.md`
7.4).

host.description:
A paired peer's label: forward the mutation to it (`protocol.md`
7.4, 10.3). Absent means this host.

ApprovalBinding.description: The approval a `merge` item asks for, bound to the head the board shows.

url.description: Where the page is served; absent for an artifact that is only a local file.

AskNote.description:
`POST /api/v1/projects/{id}/asks`: a note typed in the board's ask box,
recorded and sent to the project's orchestrator as `tiller ask note` does.

host.description:
A paired peer's label: the note is recorded on that host
(`protocol.md` 7.4).

text.description: The ask, in the owner's words; multi-line.

AskedRow.description: An unresolved ask, from the `asked` view.

as_of.description:
A peer row's freshness: the peer's `server_time` of the newest frame
its cache took. Absent on this host's rows.

host.description:
The owning host's label, on every row once a peer is paired
(`protocol.md` 7.3); absent on a host with none.

oneOf.description: A peer row's link state; absent on this host's rows.

source.description:
Where the ask came from: `prompt` (typed in an agent's pane),
`board`, `script` or `import`. Absent on a row from a peer that
predates it.

summary.description:
The ask's first line, at most 200 characters. Only on this host's
rows: a peer link carries no ask text.

as_of.description:
A peer row's freshness: the peer's `server_time` of the newest frame
its cache took. Absent on this host's rows.

evidence.description: Text, or a JSON list of pointers (event ids, artifact ids, PR urls).

host.description:
The owning host's label, on every row once a peer is paired
(`protocol.md` 7.3); absent on a host with none.

host_id.description: The owning host's id, once a peer is paired; absent otherwise.

oneOf.description: A peer row's link state; absent on this host's rows.

Why an open item no longer applies; absent while it does and once it
is answered or withdrawn.

subject_project_id.description: The project the question is about, when it names one.

subject_session_id.description: The live session the question is about, when it names one.

AttentionOption.description: One answer the asker offers, with what it sets in motion.

oneOf.description:
The owner-only change picking this option applies on this host's
board; absent when it applies none.

AwayBriefResponse.description:
`GET /api/v1/away/brief`: the return brief of the newest away contract,
or `null` when the owner has never been away. `brief.away` says whether
the contract still binds.

reason.description: Why away mode ended; "ended by the owner" when absent.

AwayScopeBody.description:
`POST` and `PUT /api/v1/away`: the scope `tiller away start` takes. `POST`
turns away mode on, `PUT` changes the running contract in place.

max_new_runs.description: No run starts once this many have started since the owner left.

projects.description: The projects the scope covers, by id.

quota_floor_percent.description: The weekly quota floor while away, 0 to 100.

until.description:
When away mode ends by itself: RFC 3339 with an offset, a date (09:00
Lisbon) or a date and time without an offset (Lisbon).

folder.description: The folder the copies are kept in.

at.description: When it was taken, or tried.

error.description:
Why it failed, or why a listed copy no longer holds: its file is
gone or its size changed. Null for a verified copy.

id.description:
The file name for a copy; `failed-<time>` for an attempt that left no
copy.

kind.description:
`nightly` (the daemon's timer) or `manual` (Back up now, or
`tiller backup`; both are the owner's).

size.description: Bytes; null for an attempt that left no copy.

BoardRow.description: One `card_column` row plus the card's own display fields.

as_of.description:
A peer row's freshness: the peer's `server_time` of the newest frame
its cache took. Absent on this host's rows.

category.description:
The card's category, for example `tiller-bug` (`state.md`, Cards);
absent with none.

column.description:
`asked`, `queued`, `working`, `landing` or `done`: how far the card's
work has come.

filed_from.description:
The project of the session that filed a Tiller bug, from its
`card.routed` event; absent for every other card.

host.description:
The owning host's label, on every row once a peer is paired
(`protocol.md` 7.3); absent on a host with none.

host_id.description: The host of the card's newest run; null for a card with no run.

oneOf.description: A peer row's link state; absent on this host's rows.

model.description: The model of the card's newest run.

needs_you.description:
The card waits on the owner (an open attention item or a permission
prompt) in whatever column it is; the Needs you filter keeps it.

observed_at.description: When the newest observation of the card's active run was made.

pr_number.description: The newest PR linked to the card.

priority.description: 0 is the most urgent, 4 the least.

head_sha.description: The commit the approval is bound to.

newer_commits.description: Commits pushed after the approval was bound, newest first.

waiting_on_this.description:
The display ids of every card that waits on this one, directly or
through other cards. This card cannot wait on any of them: that would
make a loop (`state.md` section 8).

url.description: The PR's page on the forge.

outcome.description:
`passed` (landed or reported), `failed` (failed or cut) or `cancelled`
(cancelled, abandoned or relaunched); null while the run is active.

oneOf.description:
The card's recomputed `card_column` row, when `card_id` is set and the
card is still on the board.

entity_state.description:
The entity's API shape when the event was sent, with its current
`rev`: an attention item, a machine, a quota window, a project, or
`{"state": ...}` for an outbox message or an approval. Null for an
entity the board refetches instead.

CheckStatus.description: One check's verdict in `tiller doctor` and `GET /api/v1/doctor`.

CheckoutCheck.description:
`GET /api/v1/projects/checkout`: what Add project would do with a Local
checkout folder, checked as it is typed.

path.description:
The folder `checkouts.<id>` would name; absent when the path itself
is refused.

plan.description:
`use` (a checkout of the repo is there) or `clone`; absent when the
folder is refused.

problem.description: Why the folder does not suit; absent when it does.

remote.description: The remote a clone would fetch.

CodeLoginBody.description:
`POST /api/v1/login`: the 8-digit code `tiller board --login` printed.
No `Debug`, so the code cannot reach a log line by accident.

host.description:
A paired peer's label: forward the mutation to it (`protocol.md`
7.4, 10.3). Absent means this host.

Contribution.description:
One published PR on the contributions view: the `prs` row with the card
that produced it.

category.description: The card's category; the board's Move sends `tiller-bug`.

host.description:
A paired peer's label: forward the mutation to it (`protocol.md`
7.4, 10.3). Absent means this host.

CreateGrant.description:
`POST /api/v1/projects/{id}/grants`, as `tiller grant create` does. Owner
only, local to the owning host; it is not forwarded to a peer.

expires.description:
When the grant ends, as `--expires` takes it; it sets
`conditions.expires_at`.

host.description: A paired peer's label. Refused: a grant is not forwarded.

head_sha.description: The head the board showed; a mismatch is 422 with the bound head.

host.description:
A paired peer's label: forward the mutation to it (`protocol.md`
7.4, 10.3). Absent means this host.

DeleteAction.description:
A step past a refused delete as the board takes it: `agent.stop` on a
session (`POST /api/v1/agents/{session}/stop`) or `card.cancel` on a
card's display id (`POST /api/v1/cards/{id}/cancel`).

target.description:
The session for `agent.stop`, the card's display id for
`card.cancel`.

DeleteProject.description:
`POST /api/v1/projects/{id}/delete`: the hard delete of one project.
Local to the owning host; it is not forwarded to a peer.

confirm.description: The project id typed again: the delete applies only when it matches.

host.description: A paired peer's label. Refused: a project delete is not forwarded.

DeleteUnblock.description: The owner's way past a refused delete.

oneOf.description:
The same step as an action the board takes through its own route,
when it is one.

command.description:
The command that starts it, when there is one. The CLI prints it;
the board reads `action` instead.

step.description: What to do, as a short imperative ("cancel its card").

DepBody.description:
`POST /api/v1/cards/{id}/deps` and `DELETE /api/v1/cards/{id}/deps`: the
card starts or stops waiting on another (`state.md` section 8). With a
peer `host`, forwarded to the host that owns both cards.

depends_on.description: The card waited on: a display id, ULID or short form.

host.description: A paired peer's card: the change is forwarded to that host.

release_reason.description:
Why the dependency was released: the target's satisfying outcome
(`landed`, `reported`, `answered`, `completed`), or `removed` by hand.
Absent while it is open, and on a row from a peer that predates it.

title.description:
The card waited on: its title, its board column (`queued`, `working`,
`landing` or `done`) and its badge (`state.md` section 6), so the card
page can show its state. Absent on a row from a peer that predates them.

Doctor.description:
`GET /api/v1/doctor`: the report of the checks `tiller doctor` runs, run
on this host just now.

DoctorCheck.description: One of the host's checks (`tiller doctor`).

code.description:
Which case of the check this is, for the checks the board words
itself: the owner marker (`unset`, `tiller`, `named_other`,
`other_system`, `other_system_daemon_running`) and the other system's
processes (`not_running`, `kept_read_only`, `both_dispatch`,
`processes_unreadable`). Absent on every other check.

required.description:
A failed required check fails `tiller doctor`; a failed optional one
is a warning.

DoctorGate.description: One project's stored merge gate, as `tiller doctor` reads it.

last_changed_at.description:
The newest `project.merge_gate_changed` event. The hourly ruleset
check only writes when the value moves, so no check time is stored.

body.description:
At most 100,000 characters (`protocol.md` 7.4). An empty body clears
it, as `tiller card edit --body ""` does.

host.description:
A paired peer's label: forward the mutation to it (`protocol.md`
7.4, 10.3). Absent means this host.

EditHost.description:
`PATCH /api/v1/host`: edit this host's label, capacity, floors or
boundary against its `rev`, as `tiller host edit` does. Local to this
host; it is not forwarded to a peer.

boundary.description:
`personal` or `work`. Refused once memory, a backup or an export
records the boundary.

host.description: A paired peer's label. Refused: a host edit is not forwarded.

label.description:
A word: a letter or digit, then letters, digits, `_` or `-`. Refused
while a peer is paired, since each peer knows this host by it.

EditProject.description:
`PATCH /api/v1/projects/{id}`: `tiller project edit` from the board,
against the `rev` the board read. An absent field stays as it is. An
empty text clears `repo`, `remote`, `deploy_workflow` and
`deploy_environment`, as an empty CLI flag does. Local to the owning
host; it is not forwarded to a peer.

capacity.description: How many builders may run at once; at least 1.

checks.description:
The commands a `direct-push` builder runs: a list, or `{"full": [..],
"no_logic": [..]}` with a lighter set for a change with no logic.

host.description: A paired peer's label. Refused: a project edit is not forwarded.

remote.description: The git remote builders push to.

host.description: The peer a forwarded mutation was for (`protocol.md` 10.3).

EventLine.description: One line of an event list, as the detail pages show it.

tone.description: `warn` or `bad`, for a line the page colors.

host.description:
A paired peer's label: forward the mutation to it (`protocol.md`
7.4, 10.3). Absent means this host.

Freshness.description: How fresh one source of the card's facts is.

GrantRow.description: One grant row and how many approvals it accepted.

conditions.description:
The version 1 conditions object (`authority.md` section 6). An
`away_approval_id` marks a grant away mode made.

revoked_at.description:
Null while the grant is live. A grant past its `expires_at` stops
matching without being revoked.

short.description: The last 7 characters of the id, as `tiller grant revoke` takes it.

Health.description: `GET /api/v1/health`: the daemon's own state. No work data.

links.description:
Each peer link's last success and last error (`protocol.md` 10.4);
absent on a host with no peers.

merge_app.description: The merge App key, as `tiller doctor`'s `merge app` line reads it.

schema.description: The schema this binary migrates to.

tools.description: Tool versions read at start, by tool name; null when not found.

host.description:
A paired peer's label: forward the mutation to it (`protocol.md`
7.4, 10.3). Absent means this host.

rev.description: The rev the board showed, for the conflict message only.

HostConfig.description:
`GET /api/v1/host-config`: the other host keys the board sets, as this
host's `config.toml` has them now, with the default each key falls back
to. `owner_guard.decider_key` is never here.

boundary.description: `personal` or `work`. A work host never pushes its memory repo.

config_error.description: Why `config.toml` could not be read; the rest is then the defaults.

herdr_terminal.description: `herdr.terminal`; absent when unset, so Open in herdr only focuses.

memory_remote.description: `memory.remote`; absent or empty keeps memory on this host.

stop_hook_mode.description:
`stop_hook_mode`: `off`, `observe` or `block-once`. An unset or
unknown value reads as `observe`.

HostFields.description:
`GET /api/v1/host`: the fields `tiller host edit` sets on this host, what
it runs and has free now, and the `rev` an edit is sent against.

boundary_recorded_by.description:
What already records the boundary, so it stays: `memory`, `a backup`
or `an export`. Null while the owner may still change it.

disk_floor_mb.description: No new agent starts while free disk is under it; null for no floor.

disk_free_mb.description: Free disk under the Tiller home now; null when it cannot be read.

lane_capacity.description: How many agents may run at once.

lanes_busy.description:
Lanes held now: one per agent a spawn reserved, until it ends. A
new agent starts only while this is under `lane_capacity`.

ram_floor_mb.description: No new agent starts while free RAM is under it; null for no floor.

ram_free_mb.description: Free RAM now; null when it cannot be read.

InterruptBody.description:
`POST /api/v1/agents/{session}/interrupt`: Escape to a working agent's
pane, and whether its turn ended within 10 s (`protocol.md` 6.4, 7.4).

host.description: A paired peer's label; an interrupt is not forwarded.

LearningConfig.description: The `[learning]` keys with their defaults (`learning-loop.md` section 10).

evals_dir.description: The checkout that holds `evals/run.sh`; absent when unset.

sample_every.description: One routine card in this many gets a full retro.

window_cards.description: Cards a kept change set is measured over.

LinkEvent.description: One `event: link` message: a peer link changed state.

last_success_at.description: When the link last took a frame.

LinkState.description:
A peer link's state (`protocol.md` 10.2): `live` with a frame in the last
25 s, `lagging` up to 2 min, `down` after that or while reconnecting
fails, `refused` after a refused `hello` or a changed `host_id`, `never`
before the first `welcome`.

Machine.description: One host the board shows (`protocol.md` section 9).

bug_project.description:
The open project `tiller bug file` routes to on this host (`state.md`,
Host); absent with none, when Tiller bugs wait in `fleet`. A peer's
is what its own row reports.

health.description:
`ok`, `degraded` or `down` for this host; `ok` or `stale` for a
remote one.

oneOf.description:
A paired peer's link state (`protocol.md` 10.2); absent for this
host and for a herdr-only machine.

link_reason.description:
Why the peer refused the link: `revoked`, `unknown_key`, `bad_sig`,
`clock_skew`, `replayed`, `version`, `accept_off`, or `host_changed`
when its `host_id` is not the paired one.

stale_reason.description:
`herdr_link_down`, `host_asleep`, `poll_failed` or `never_seen`; for a
paired peer also `peer_link_down`, `peer_refused` or `peer_version`.

version.description:
The `tiller version` string this host runs, for example
`0.1.0-pre.17`: this host's own build, or what a paired peer reports
on its own row. Absent for a herdr-only machine and for a peer that
has not reported one.

MarkRecapSeen.description: `POST /api/v1/recap/seen`: moves the recap mark to now.

host.description: A paired peer's label. Refused: the mark is this daemon's.

MarkReplyRead.description:
`POST /api/v1/replies/{id}/read`: marks a reply read. Marking it again
changes nothing.

host.description:
A paired peer's label. Refused: a reply is read on the daemon that
holds it, not forwarded.

MemoryChange.description:
One entry in a document's "Change history": a change applied or
discarded in the last 30 days, newest first, undone or not.

by.description: Who wrote it: `you`, `the curator` or the proposing session.

from.description: The card it came from, else who wrote it.

undone_at.description:
When it was undone: its reverse applied, or its discard proposed
again.

MemoryDecide.description:
`POST /api/v1/memory/proposals/decide`: Keep or Discard on agent
proposals, each with its own approval row, applied in order.

base_blob.description: The blob the board showed the proposal against.

blob.description: The blob at `HEAD`; every change sends it back as `base_blob`.

dirty.description:
The working tree differs from `HEAD`: changes are refused until it is
committed or reset.

MemoryEdit.description: `POST /api/v1/memory/edits`: one owner edit, committed at once.

base_blob.description: The blob the board showed; another is 422.

host.description: Refused unless absent or this host: memory is never forwarded.

index.description: The line's position in its section, for `rewrite` and `remove`.

MemoryEvalJob.description: A holdout eval the board started.

error.description: Why it recorded nothing; absent while it runs.

MemoryEvalPlan.description:
`GET /api/v1/memory/proposals/{id}/eval`: what the holdout eval of a
proposal will cost, and why it will not start, before the owner starts
it.

case_runs.description: Runs of the role's model, one per run of each case.

change_set.description:
The change set it runs on: the proposal's open set, or the one-member
set a start makes.

minutes.description: The minutes it will probably run (an estimate).

percent.description: The weekly quota percent it will probably take (an estimate).

refusal.description: Why a start is refused now; absent when it can start.

MemoryEvalQuota.description: The weekly quota a holdout eval is checked against.

floor.description: This host's floor for new work; absent with no quota feed.

label.description: The weekly window with the least left.

left.description: Percent left in it; absent when unknown.

host.description: Refused unless absent or this host: memory is never forwarded.

MemoryGate.description:
`learning.gate` on a proposal (learning-loop.md, section 7), with a
proposal made against another text refused as stale.

oneOf.description: The set that is measuring and blocks every other, with cards to go.

reason.description: The failing step, when not ok.

MemoryHoldout.description: The newest holdout run of a suggestion's change set.

current.description: The run was made with the set's current members.

index.description: Its position in the section, as edits name it.

oneOf.description: A rewrite or removal of this line.

MemoryLoad.description: A session that loaded a revision.

MemoryProvenance.description: Where a line came from: the revision that last changed it.

card.description: The card's display id, when a card is behind it.

note.description: `you`, `carried over`, `outside Tiller` or the proposing session.

base_blob.description: The blob the board showed: the document's current head.

evals.description:
The holdout evals the board started that are running, or that failed
with no later recorded run of their change set, across restarts.

approval.description: The approval row that applied it.

text.description: The file's text at this revision; absent once the blob is gone.

suggestions.description:
New lines suggested for the section, and suggestions whose line is
gone.

eval_clears.description:
A holdout run is the next step, and the board offers "Run holdout
eval...".

gate.description: The holdout gate's verdict on keeping it; Keep waits until it passes.

oneOf.description: The newest holdout run of its change set.

moved.description:
The document changed after it was proposed: "Re-propose on current
text" clears it.

moved_at.description: When Tiller recorded the text that moved it, if it did.

target.description:
The current text of the line a rewrite or removal names, while the
file has it.

MergeAppHealth.description:
The merge App key under `~/.tiller/forge-app/`: names files and the
reason, never the key.

app_id.description: The App's numeric id, when the key loads.

status.description:
`ok`, `missing` (every project runs as `detect`), `warn` (the key is
not used) or `fail` (the key is readable by group or others).

host.description:
The peer that applied a forwarded mutation (`protocol.md` 10.3);
absent for this host's own.

warning.description:
What the owner should know about a mutation that applied, such as
why a re-added project's cards do not start at 1.

NewCheckout.description:
Add project's Local checkout: a folder that is a checkout of the project
already, or one to clone the project into before it is added.

clone.description:
Clone the repo into the folder, which must be missing or empty.
`false`: the folder must be a checkout of the repo already.

path.description:
An absolute path, or one that starts with `~/`. Empty:
`<spawn.checkouts_root>/<id>`.

NoPrompt.description: Why a prompt read found no dialog.

oneOf.description: Sets one project's capacity, refused when it is no longer `from`.

OwnerAction.description:
An owner-only change an option applies when the owner picks it
(`state.md`, Attention).

PairedPeer.description: A host this board is paired with: `tiller peer list`'s `peers`.

fingerprint.description:
`SHA256:` and the base64 SHA-256 of the public key this board signs
with; `None` when the key file is missing or does not parse.

host.description: Refused unless absent or this host: a pairing is never forwarded.

PauseBody.description:
`POST /api/v1/agents/{session}/pause`: `tiller run pause` on the
session's run.

host.description: A paired peer's label; a pause is not forwarded.

reason.description: Why the run waits, at most 20,000 characters.

PauseInfo.description: A run's dated pause, as the newest `run.paused` event records it.

by.description:
Who took it: `board`, `owner`, the worker's own session or its
orchestrator's.

until.description: When the pause stops silencing the run's alarms.

PeerEvent.description:
One `event: peer` message: a paired peer's change, with no SSE `id`, since

key_files_left.description:
The labels of hosts no longer paired whose key file is still here,
by label: an unpair whose delete failed. Unpair again deletes it.

One `event: peer_reset` message, sent per peer after a reconnecting
stream's replay: the peer's cached rows replace what the board holds.

A peer row's freshness: the peer's `server_time` of the newest frame
its cache took. Absent on this host's rows.

host.description:
The owning host's label, on every row once a peer is paired
(`protocol.md` 7.3); absent on a host with none.

oneOf.description: A peer row's link state; absent on this host's rows.

as_of.description:
A peer row's freshness: the peer's `server_time` of the newest frame
its cache took. Absent on this host's rows.

When `rev` last moved: an edit, a stage change, a new card. Null only

effective_delivery.description:
The mode builders and the land loop follow: `delivery`, or

host.description:
The owning host's label, on every row once a peer is paired
(`protocol.md` 7.3); absent on a host with none.

host_id.description: The owning host's id, once a peer is paired; absent otherwise.

oneOf.description: A peer row's link state; absent on this host's rows.

next_review_due.description: When the next weekly review is due, while pre-launch.

retired_at.description:
When the project was retired; present only on the archived list
(`?retired=true`).

reviewed_at.description:
When `reviewed_through_sha` was last set: a pass finished, or the
project became pre-launch.

reviewed_through_sha.description: The last commit a batched review covered.

A running agent of a project: a live session, or an active run with no

session.description: The live session; absent for an active run with no live session.

Why the delete is refused now (a live run or session, the fleet

Rows per table the delete removes, the project row and its events

What clears `refused`, when the owner can clear it: absent for the

Worktrees with commits not landed or uncommitted changes. The delete

ProjectRetirePreview.description:
`GET /api/v1/projects/{id}/retire`: whether a retire would apply now

refused.description:
Why the retire is refused now (an open card, the fleet project);
absent when it would apply.

ProjectSetup.description:
`GET /api/v1/projects/{id}/setup`: what `tiller doctor`'s `merge_gates`
line and `tiller config get checkouts.<id>` show for one of this host's
projects.

config_error.description: Why `config.toml` could not be read; `checkout` is then absent.

merge_gate.description: `enforced` (GitHub refuses a merge the App did not make) or `detect`.

merge_gate_changed_at.description:
The newest `project.merge_gate_changed` event. The hourly ruleset

repo.description: The GitHub repo, `owner/name`; absent for a project with none.

ProjectUnlanded.description: A worktree of a project with work not landed.

card.description: The display id of the card whose run made it, when known.

dirty.description: Uncommitted changes; absent when not yet read.

unlanded_commits.description: Commits not on the base branch; absent when not yet read.

PromptAnswer.description:
`POST /api/v1/agents/{session}/prompt/answer`: the option to press, on
the dialog `screen` names.

screen.description: The `screen` of the prompt read the buttons were drawn from.

The tool the session's hook named; the dialog's title is one Claude
Code gives it. Empty for a dialog no tool asks, such as `trust`.

fetch_error.description: A short code for the last failed run, never quota-axi's stderr.

seen_at.description: When the owner last marked a recap seen; null before the first.

since.description: The start of the window counted: `seen_at`, or a day back.

RelabelBody.description:

note.description:
The progress the new session starts from, at most 20,000

sessions.description:
Only these sessions, the ones the person saw; all stale sessions when

RetireProject.description:

stop_agents.description:

host.description: Refused unless absent or this host: a retro run is never forwarded.

RetroStatus.description: Where a full retro is now.

One full retro, as Memory's Retros list and Health's Learning panel

curator_started_at.description: When its newest curator run started.

learning.description:
The learning it kept, or for an unfinished retro why it did not

run_refusal.description:
Why Run again is refused now, in plain words; `None` when it would

retros.description:

head_sha.description:

pane_tail.description:

owner.description: Whether this browser holds a live owner cookie.

interventions.description: Why the developer was needed, after the developer's own relabels.

peers.description:

Stop the live orchestrator first and start a new one, as `tiller
orchestrator start --restart` does: only on the owner's explicit
Restart, and never for a peer's (its forwarded owner may not).

StartSettings.description:
`GET /api/v1/start-settings`: the host-level settings an orchestrator
start reads, as this host's `config.toml` has them.

config_error.description: Why `config.toml` could not be read; the rest is then absent.

orchestrator_home.description:
Where each project's orchestrator home sits (`spawn.orchestrator_home`
or its default). Derived: the board shows it, and does not set it.

problems.description:
What a start would refuse about the host-level settings. A project's
checkout is judged with the project.

scratch_root.description: The run scratch root (`spawn.scratch_root` or its default). Derived.

SteerBody.description:
`POST /api/v1/agents/{session}/steer`: one line for the agent, typed
into its pane when the pane is idle (`protocol.md` 3.3, 7.4).

host.description: A paired peer's label; a steer is not forwarded.

Always refused with a peer label: a backup copies this host's own
database and never leaves its folder.

TerminalFit.description: The size the Fit asks herdr to give a pane, in cells.

TerminalHistory.description:
The pane's recent rows as herdr renders them: wrapped at the pane's
width, oldest first, the screen itself last, with their colors as ANSI
escapes and rows split by `\n`.

TerminalHistoryAsk.description:
`POST /api/v1/agents/{session}/terminal/history`: how much of the
pane's scrollback to read.

host.description: A paired peer's label; a history read is not forwarded.

lines.description:
1 to 1000 rendered rows, counted from the bottom of the screen;
absent means 1000.

host.description: A paired peer's label; input is not forwarded.

keys.description:
Keys pressed in order, as `herdr pane send-keys` names them:
`enter`, `esc`, `ctrl+c`, `left`, `space`, or one character. Up to 64.

text.description: Text pasted as one bracketed paste, up to 4096 bytes.

oneOf.description:
The pane's size in cells. It opens the stream and comes again when
the pane is resized; a full frame follows it.

One herdr frame: the ANSI bytes, base64. A `full` frame redraws the
whole screen; the frames after it are diffs, `seq` counting up by
one.
The pane closed; the stream ends.
herdr stopped answering; the stream ends.

herdr would not resize the pane for the Fit, most often because
another client controls it. The stream goes on at the pane's own size,
with a `size` line next.

TerminalLine.description: One line of the terminal mirror's NDJSON stream (`protocol.md` 7.4).

oneOf.description:
The board's own size for the pane: herdr resizes the pane to it while
the stream is open and back when it ends (Terminal mirror, Fit).
Absent means the pane keeps its size and only the picture scales.

host.description:
A paired peer's label; the mirror is not forwarded (`protocol.md`
7.4).

TerminalRefit.description:
`POST /api/v1/agents/{session}/terminal/fit`: a new board size for the
Fit an open stream holds on the agent's pane.

host.description: A paired peer's label; a refit is not forwarded.

TerminalTail.description:
The pane's visible screen as herdr renders it, one row per line split by
`\n`, colors as ANSI escapes, and the pane's size in cells.

TerminalTailAsk.description:
`POST /api/v1/agents/{session}/terminal/tail`: nothing to ask beyond
the agent.

host.description: A paired peer's label; a tail read is not forwarded.

quote.description:
The words the line quotes: a reply's body on `ask.replied`. Absent
from a peer that predates replies.

host.description:
A paired peer's label: forward the mutation to it (`protocol.md`
7.4, 10.3). Absent means this host.

outcome.description:
`close` only, and required there: the outcome, such as `completed`,
`abandoned` or `superseded`.

host.description:
A paired peer's label: the withdraw is not forwarded, so a peer's
item is refused (`protocol.md` 7.4).

tags.name: reads
tags.description: Reads: any request that passes the Host check on loopback; at an --allow-host name, only with the owner cookie

tags.name: mutations
tags.description: Mutations: owner cookie, JSON body, same origin

tags.name: session
tags.description: Signing in with a code, signing out, and whether this browser is signed in
